deviations.why: No real testimonial data available in Vitrina data contract; creating fake testimonials is prohibited.
No booking flow exists; data contract does not support form submission handling.

notes: Timeline nodes map to d.services, with duration displayed in the date column as a real business metric. If d.gallery has fewer than 3 images, hero uses available ones; gallery section falls back to first two images. All colours are defined via the 11 spine variables in .root, no hex outside. No !important used.
